color.bg: Page background. Tinted, never plain gray (ADR-0050).
color.surface-2: Quiet areas inside a card: notes, logo tiles, chips, group counts.
color.border-strong: Borders of fields, buttons and segmented controls.
color.text: Body text on bg, surface and surface-2.
color.muted: Secondary text: labels, meta, inactive tabs, on bg, surface and surface-2.
color.faint: Captions, sub-stats, icons in fields; on bg and surface. Source pair that misses: faint on surface-2 in the light themes is 4.20:1 (under 4.5) — prefer bg or surface there.
color.hover: Background of a hovered secondary button, row or toggle.
color.active: Background of a pressed button and a selected segment.
color.accent: Links, the Subscription chip, the version pill with an update, a pinned account.
color.accent-soft: Soft fill behind accent text: chip-accent, selected tab, pin mark.
color.focus: Focus outline (2px solid) and focused field border; the focused Theme dot.
color.primary-hover: Main action button fill on hover.
color.primary-active: Main action button fill when pressed.
color.on-primary: Main action button label on primary, primary-hover and primary-active (3:1 floor allowed: weight 650).
color.primary-hover-border: Main action button border on hover and press.
color.btn-text: Secondary button text; follows text unless a Theme sets it.
color.btn-hover-border: Secondary button border on hover; hovered fields, checkboxes and tool cards.
color.ok: Positive status text on ok-soft and surface (chip-ok, tag-ok, healthy stats).
color.ok-soft: Background of ok chips and tags.
color.warn: Warning text (running out) on warn-soft and surface.
color.warn-soft: Background of warn chips, tags and a pressed attention stat.
color.fail: Error text (used up, broken) on fail-soft and surface; error card border.
color.fail-soft: Background of fail chips and tags.
color.ok-bar: Quota bar fill, normal; live dot. Never red or amber.
color.warn-bar: Quota bar fill, running out; stale dot, attention dots.
color.fail-bar: Quota bar fill, used up; error dots.
color.track: Empty part of a quota bar. Source pairs that miss: ok-bar, warn-bar and fail-bar on track are under 3:1 in the light themes (1.4–2.9:1) — always show the percentage beside a bar, colored warn/fail at those levels, so state never rests on the bar color alone.
color.logo-bg: The 40px tile behind the sideby mark in the page header. Stays light in dark mode: the painted mark is made for a light ground.
color.logo-line: Inset 1px ring of the logo tile (none in dark mode).
color.logo-fg: The brand blue (ADR-0050). It no longer colours the mark, which is a painting (ADR-0064); kept so Themes and Portals that set logoColor still load.

title.usage: Page title (the sideby name in the header). --title-size, --title-weight.

stat-value.usage: The four summary numbers. Tabular numerals.

body.usage: All body text. --font-size; the body sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

control.usage: Button labels (btn); the main button uses 650. --control-size, --button-weight.

tagline.usage: The line under the page title, in muted.

tag.usage: Small status tags inside rows (tag, tag-ok, tag-warn, tag-fail).

version-pill.usage: The version pill after the name; aliases in tags (tag-alias, weight 400).

kbd.usage: Keyboard hint inside the search field.

radius.radius: Cards, panels, summary strip; banners and notes derive smaller radii from it (radius − 4px).
radius.ctl-radius: Buttons, fields, segmented controls, group toggles.

size.content-width: Maximum width of the page content.

sizeNote: Control heights and page width from the Panel (--ctl-h, --ctl-h-sm, --field-h, --content-width).

shadow.shadow: Cards, group lists and the summary strip. None in dark mode: borders carry the edge.
